verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Stripe serves an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com with agent-directed instructions. A second probe confirms Invoicing doc pages are available as raw markdown (e.g. invoicing.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown-docs offering, and independent community corroboration of agents using it for Invoicing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt # Stripe Documentation
When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing.md # Invoicing
